taxonomic_note: Kew/POWO accepts Scutellaria ovata as a Texas-native species with recognized infraspecific structure. The learner remains at species rank; accepted variety records may support the species-level county concept.
look_here_first: First check size and leaves. This is a much taller rhizomatous perennial than the small local skullcaps, with large triangular-ovate leaves, truncate to shallowly heart-shaped bases, crenate margins, and relatively large blue-violet flowers.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Travis is locked by UT Plant Resources Center specimens; Hays and Gillespie are documented in the Smithsonian monographic treatment under accepted S. ovata var. bracteata and roll up to the species-level learner concept.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Keep variety identity separate unless diagnostic evidence supports it; county evidence at an accepted infraspecific rank may support the species-level occurrence without assigning a variety to an unknown plant.

best_field_traits: rhizomatous perennial, substantially taller than S. drummondii and S. wrightii
often about 35–70 cm tall in regional treatments
leaf bases truncate to shallowly cordate
leafy raceme with bilaterally symmetric blue-violet flowers
two-lipped Scutellaria calyx with the projecting visorlike scutellum
corollas much larger than S. drummondii, roughly 21–25 mm in regional comparison treatments
morphology_keys.comparison_training: S. drummondii is a small glandular-hairy annual with acute leaves and much smaller flowers; S. wrightii is a low bushy perennial with small rounded entire leaves. S. ovata is taller, rhizomatous, and conspicuously larger-leaved and larger-flowered.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Tall rhizomatous habit plus large triangular-ovate crenate leaves and large flowers separates S. ovata from the much smaller local annual/perennial skullcaps.

diagnostic_image_needs: side-by-side scale comparison with S. drummondii and S. wrightii
photo_note: Exact diagnostic photo locking remains later visual enrichment; the current scientific curation is not blocked on photo perfection.
